newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin at $70/live-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin at $70/live-private.

text.p: Nebraska direct cattle trade near midday Tuesday was slow but with a firm tone on a few sales reported, market sources said.
About 100 heifers were reported sold on a live basis at $70.00 per cwt early. Further asking levels at $70.00 to $71.00 were countered by packer bids at $69.00 to $70.00, sources said.
Packers were bidding $115.00 to $116.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with light sales on Monday. Asking levels ranged from $116.00 to $117.00, they said.
About 83,000 head were estimated on this week's showlist. The number is near unchanged from last week, sources said.
